# Camstage

> > Camstage provides fire-retardant theatrical fabrics and stage curtains, specializing in velvet velour, wool serge, and cyclorama materials for performance venues and exhibitions.

Camstage supplies professional-grade stage curtain fabrics, acoustic treatments, and exhibition materials that meet international fire safety standards including BS5867, NFPA 701, EN13773, and B1/M1 certifications. Their product range includes velvet velour, wool serge, display felt, and specialized cyclorama cloths for theatrical, broadcast, and event applications.

## Key Topics

- BS5867 fire safety certification
- NFPA 701 flame retardant standard
- EN13773 European fire classification
- IFR (Inherently Fire Retardant) fabrics
- DFR (Durably Fire Retardant) treatment
- NDFR (Non-Durably Fire Retardant)
- Velvet velour acoustic curtains
- Wool serge stage drapes
- Cyclorama cloth and projection surfaces
- Blackout fabric for light control
- Acoustic treatment materials
- Exhibition carpet and display felt
- B1 and M1 fire classifications
- Stage curtain manufacturing
- Theatrical drapery solutions
